blocks.text: IBA, Zambales — More than 2,000 electric vehicles could pass through the Subic Bay Freeport a month, the Subic Bay Metropolitan Authority (SBMA) anticipates, as demand for electric vehicles in the country rises. In a statement on Monday, the SBMA said the projection follows the recent arrival of 100 vehicles, 80 hybrid and 20 fully electric, in what the agency described as the first delivery of a major electric vehicle brand to the Freeport.
